selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, isolated ingress tests passed for TCP/22 and TCP/8080 and confirmed rejection of TCP/9090 despite an active listener.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID f43f62f7-d815-4b53-87de-c2dfdd0252da, received reboot acknowledgement, observed disconnection, and confirmed new boot ID f74d010a-bc30-4d0d-b681-76502146286b with nftables, sshd, configuration checksum, rules, and traffic behavior recovered.

set -u

ip netns exec fwtest ip link set lo up

ip netns exec fwtest ip route add "$NODE_IP"/32 via 192.0.2.1
nc -l -p 8080 >/tmp/fwtest-8080.log 2>&1 & P8080=$!

sleep 1
echo 'LISTENERS_BEFORE_TEST:'

if ip netns exec fwtest nc -z -w 2 "$NODE_IP" 8080; then echo 'TCP_8080_ALLOWED=PASS'; else echo 'TCP_8080_ALLOWED=FAIL'; RESULT=1; fi
if ip netns exec fwtest nc -z -w 2 "$NODE_IP" 9090; then echo 'TCP_9090_REJECTED=FAIL'; RESULT=1; else echo 'TCP_9090_REJECTED=PASS'; fi
kill "$P8080" "$P9090" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$P8080" "$P9090" 2>/dev/null || true
ip netns del fwtest
ip link del fwtest-host 2>/dev/null || true
exit "$RESULT"
